## What's Changed
* fix(vega): translate engine's string-keyed choice labels back to caller's labels by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1519
* build(deps): bump actions/setup-java from 6.2.0 to 6.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1520
* build(deps): bump actions/setup-go from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1521
* build(deps): bump ruff from 0.17.4 to 0.17.5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1522
* build(deps-dev): bump vitest from 5.1.0 to 5.1.1 in /laya-ts by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1523
* fix(onnx): verify fused exports against the selected checkpoint by @chetanxrathore in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1524
* fix(onnx-export): the cleanup deletes a session the Windows lane never opens by @Rukafuu in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1525
* fix(lang): add unaccented and closed-class Spanish/Portuguese stopwords for short text by @Rukafuu in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1526
* fix(ts): a null or blank per-model revision inherits Router.revision, as Python does by @dante01yoon in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1528

## New Contributors
* @chetanxrathore made their first contribution in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1524
* @dante01yoon made their first contribution in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1528

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/compare/v0.5.2...v0.5.3

name: v1.4.272
body:
## More reliable bots that pick up where they left off ✨ - 🤖 **Bots recover more reliably after interruptions.** Conversations paused by usage limits can continue automatically after an account switch or restart. Resume works for chats interrupted by a crash or restart, and with **Resume work on restart** enabled, terminal workers can return to their saved conversations even if their terminals were lost. [Usage-limit recovery](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47221) · [Chat recovery](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47284) · [Worker recovery](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46643) - 🌐 **Use the same browser tools across machines.** Extensions such as 1Password now work in SSH workspace tabs and paired-server tabs opened on **This device**. Drop files from your desktop into server-streamed pages, and let agents on SSH hosts or paired servers upload and download files using paths on their own host. [Extensions](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47347) · [Drag and drop](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47357) · [SSH files](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47399) · [Paired-server files](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47264) - 💬 **Take a quick detour in chat.** On supported agents, type `/btw` or `/side` to mark a draft as a side chat. The composer’s worker count now reflects who’s actively working. [Side chat](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42129) · [Worker count](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47432) - 💤 **Free up idle resources.** Memory Saver now unloads hidden **This device** browser tabs and restores them when you or an agent needs them. An idle WSL distro can stop while Orca stays open and wake when you need it again. [Memory Saver](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47291) · [WSL](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47434) - 📱 **More room to work from your phone.** With the matching mobile build, you can post photos in group rooms, handle agent requests across paired computers from **Needs you**, and delete chats from an agent’s **Chats** tab. [Group photos](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47361) · [Agent requests](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47344) · [Delete chats](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47339) ## About Orca Bots (Beta) - **Resume a failed turn from Slack.** A linked Slack thread can offer **Resume** so you can retry the failed turn and pick up queued work from the thread. **Open this thread in Orca** also works for bots on paired servers. [Resume](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47233) · [Thread links](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47486) - **Get replies while workers keep going.** Replies on GitHub, Linear, and Discord go out when the turn that wrote them finishes, even if its workers are still running. [Reply delivery](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47532) - **See what work is waiting on.** Items can show **Waiting** with a reason such as CI, a review, or a deploy. Questions that need your attention still appear in **Needs you**. [Waiting status](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47308) · [Item status display](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47309) - **Easier GitHub and Slack setup.** GitHub’s **Add org** and **Refresh** let you pick an account and rediscover organizations it can already access. Slack setup lets you choose a workspace when there’s more than one. [GitHub setup](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47467) · [Slack setup](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47505) - **Debug webhook automations faster.** Copy a webhook URL from setup, the automation menu, or its page. The CLI counts calls that filters ignored and shows the reason when the server supplies it. [Copy URL](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47479) · [Webhook inspection](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47483) --- ## What's Changed

name: v1.4.271
body: Following [1.4.269](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.269), here is the next round of Orca. Bots reach Qwen Code and span your paired computers, the phone app manages agents end to end, and chats get lighter and quicker. ## Bots across computers, a phone that runs your agents & snappier chats ✨ One bot group can now hold bots from your paired computers, bots can run on Qwen Code, chats can be deleted and continue on their own after a usage limit, and the phone app can share, import and connect agents without the desktop. - 🤖 **Bots across computers and agents:** One bot group can hold bots from paired computers, bots can run on Qwen Code, and group rooms hand follow-up turns to every member an agent @mentions. - 📱 **Run agents from your phone:** Edit an agent's automations, connect Slack, Linear, GitHub, Google and Composio, share an agent by link, import one from OpenClaw or Hermes, read its soul and manage its memory and skills, and hand a history session to another agent. These need the matching mobile build. - 💬 **Calmer chats:** Delete a chat, continue after a usage limit by default, list folders in the @ menu, and see quieter rows and a composer that keeps its welcome text clear. - 🐧 **Steadier Windows and WSL:** WSL hosts count working agents for keep-awake, Codex accounts and settings behave on WSL, and moving a folder to a WSL host asks first. - ⚡ **Lighter all around:** Terminal title changes, agent status updates, bot lists and phone refreshes stop rescanning or rebuilding everything, and hidden animations pause. - 🐙 **More than one GitHub account:** Link several GitHub accounts, with leaner link previews and comment polling. ## About Orca Bots (Beta) Orca Bots work like first-class teammates: they now span your computers, remember what they finished, and pick up where a usage limit or restart cut them off. - **Qwen Code behind your bots:** Qwen Code joins the agents a bot can run on. - 🖥️ **One group, many computers:** A bot group can hold bots from paired computers, and an agent's answer to a peer's request shows in the room. - 📓 **Memory that keeps up:** Bots journal each closed item and its PRs, know that work state lives in Items and the journal, and a pilot Tidy-up moves and merges memory lines instead of rewriting them. - 🔁 **Picks up where it left off:** After a restart or a usage-limit pause, bots keep their open requests and continue them once. - 💬 **Easier replies:** Item comment boxes get the composer's mention and slash pickers, and "Replying to" jumps to the question it answers. ## Known issue - ⚠️ **Bots can pause their work:** After the app restarts, or after an error such as hitting a usage limit, a bot can stop partway through its work. This will be fixed in the next version. ## Coming soon - Antigravity bug fixes - More connectors - Easier moving of bots between different machines - More performance improvements - Fix bots stall rescanning every workspace each time they re-sort by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46180 * Cut 173 KB from the phone page so its size fence has headroom again by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46183 * Remove in-process CPU profiling from the hang watchdog by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46185 * Fleet perf gate: fail when main keeps memory for each idle chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46243 * Agent status changes no longer rebuild the workspace's tab list each time by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46246 * Stop re-scanning every saved tab for each chat's title by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46247 * Read a Run's inbox through its index instead of scanning all mail by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46477 * Bot chat tree stops re-reading finished workers on every refresh by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46478 * Paired phones get only the agent-list rows that changed by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46479 * Terminal title changes update the app once instead of twice by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46507 * Let a forced update past a terminal daemon that is provably not running by @nwparker in body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.85

Released on 2026-11-23.

Apps that embed Studio can now read a sealed preview's page markup. Undo keeps a save made during an import, sealed resizes keep the dragged corner under the pointer, and the skills ask before usage notes or destroy.

## Features

- **Studio:** Apps embedding Studio can read a sealed preview's page markup ([3134c5f1b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3134c5f1b88295d7b6507228a4c2ddeb3298c846), [#8564](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8564)).

## Fixes

# HyperFrames v0.9.84

Released on 2026-11-23.

A new blank project opens on an empty timeline again. Leftover render folders are cleaned up reliably on macOS and Windows, and capture finishes on a small host with no GPU.

## Fixes

# HyperFrames v0.9.82

Released on 2026-11-22.

A preview loads GSAP's motion path plugin from the page's own GSAP folder or the host's copy, so it works with no network. Sealed previews get more fixes, from sound and the keyboard to moves inside nested compositions.

## Fixes

- **Producer:** A render serves every GSAP the CLI ships, and its own when the CDN is blocked ([8c9c94572](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8c9c94572a148c62675a4e181cec1e3480e75bc4), [#8349](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8349)).
- **Core:** The motion path plugin loads from beside the page's own GSAP, never a CDN it did not name ([80f45de33](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/80f45de33da92c8f765fd184a0ac4cb8e2ade261), [#8523](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8523)).
- **Producer:** A film with many clips of one 4K video no longer freezes the render probe ([4daeb78c3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4daeb78c3d8c2f7ab154613b13f6a1d74485d394), [#8284](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8284)).

name: V3.21.0 Doorway
body:
Pake V3.21.0

Turn any webpage into a desktop app with one command.

### Changelog 1. A link in a mail to another site's sign-in page, such as `github.com/login` or a `/auth/verify` link, now opens in the default browser instead of replacing the page, as it did in an Outlook web mail app. A site's own sign-in still stays in the app. 2. A Cmd-click on macOS, a Ctrl-click on Windows and Linux, or a middle-click opens the link in the default browser, as in a browser. 3. Ctrl+Shift+H and the Home menu item leave a window the page opened alone, so a sign-in popup is never sent to the app's home page halfway through. 4. The runtime moves to Tauri 2.12.7, Wry 0.57.3 and url 2.5.9, which fixes RUSTSEC-2026-0592, where a nested `blob:` address could abort an app while downloading. 5. The CLI now needs Node.js 22.12 or later. ### 更新日志 1. 邮件里指向别的网站登录页的链接，比如 `github.com/login` 或 `/auth/verify` 这类，现在会在默认浏览器里打开，不再像之前在 Outlook 网页邮箱应用里那样把页面整个换掉，网站自己的登录还是留在应用里。 2. macOS 上按住 Command 点、Windows 和 Linux 上按住 Ctrl 点，或者用中键点链接，会和浏览器一样在默认浏览器里打开。 3. Ctrl+Shift+H 和菜单里的回到首页不再作用于网页自己打开的窗口，登录弹窗不会在登录到一半时被带回应用首页。 4. 运行时升到 Tauri 2.12.7、Wry 0.57.3 和 url 2.5.9，修复了 RUSTSEC-2026-0592，之前嵌套的 `blob:` 地址可能在下载时让应用直接退出。 5. CLI 现在需要 Node.js 22.12 或更高版本。 If Pake helps you, please consider giving it a star and recommending it to your friends. ### Pake App If you would rather click than type commands, [Pake App](https://pake.run/) makes apps from a ready-made gallery or any URL on Mac, Windows and Linux, with no Node.js or Rust to install, and adds ad blocking and updates for the apps you made. You can [download it here](https://pake.run/). The CLI stays free and open source. > https://github.com/tw93/Pake

name: v0.48.0
body:
## New features

- Sync ChatGPT history through Chrome from the Import dialog or with `agentsview source import --type chatgpt --sync`. Later runs fetch only chats whose update time changed. If you already use Chrome Sync, rerun `agentsview source chrome setup` and reload the extension.
- Sync text from signed-in Gemini Apps chats through Chrome with `agentsview source import --type gemini-apps --sync`. Each chat imports as one session.
- Sync Grok web chats through Chrome while signed in with `agentsview source import --type grok-web --sync`. Each import contains the text of the branch shown on grok.com.
- Press `t` in a session to search typed prompts and jump to one, even in transcript history that hasn't loaded yet. The picker follows the transcript's block filters.
- Find messages by words in any order on SQLite with FTS5 and on PostgreSQL and ClickHouse mirrors. By default, natural multi-word queries rank exact text first, then matches with every word, then partial matches. On SQLite, this word matching applies to non-CJK queries.
- Find sessions by text inside tool-result images from the search palette or `agentsview session search`. Enable `[image_text]` with a loopback GLM-OCR endpoint and restart the daemon to index new and retained images.
- Use the PR filter to find sessions whose prompts name a pull request. Local archives pick up retained prompt mentions when opened after upgrade. For hosted sessions, run `agentsview replica pg raw-reparse hosted --run-id <id> --batch-size 64`.
- Browse Factory Droid sessions with subagent links when the transcript identifies the parent. Token usage is available when the settings file can be read, and subagent usage appears on the parent session.
- Browse Muse Personal sessions with thinking, tool calls and results, and compaction summaries. Have Muse install the AgentsView CLI on its hosted machine, sync there, and push to a shared PostgreSQL database.
- Report token usage for tools that call model APIs directly with the `direct-api` provider. AgentsView reads usage records without message bodies and counts them on the Usage page.
- Install conversation search skills and register the MCP server for Claude Code and Codex with `agentsview agent setup`. Use `--check` to inspect setup or `--mcp=false` to work with skills while keeping a custom MCP entry.
- Install AgentsView Memory from the AgentsView repository marketplace for Claude Code and choose the server each project uses. The plugin's search agent can search past conversations and read the source in its own context.
- First-time users with session history get a Get started checklist on the Dashboard for opening sessions, searching history, viewing token use, and exploring insights. It goes away when completed or dismissed.
- Choose Match device in Settings > Appearance > Theme to follow the light or dark setting reported by your browser or desktop app. AgentsView switches when the reported setting changes.
- Turn on Always show year in Settings > Appearance to include the year in sidebar dates, message timestamps, the session header, and command palette results.
- Apply a saved tool-result image policy with Restart now in Settings. Servers that can't restart themselves show manual steps, and remote access auth changes apply when saved.
- Read saved tool results through MCP with `include_results` on `get_tool_calls`. Results mask detected secrets, and `result_cursor` reads the next chunk of an unchanged result.
- Page through large MCP pattern searches, message reads, and tool-call results. Responses report omitted content and return a cursor where paging is supported. For truncated semantic or hybrid searches, retry with a smaller `limit`.
- Check MCP call counts, error rates, and rates of server-marked truncation by tool with `agentsview mcp calls`. The report also shows empty-result rates for supported first-page searches.
- Read compaction summaries with `agentsview session compactions` or MCP `get_compaction_summaries`. Look up one session or list sessions active since a timestamp. Daemon-backed reads require API 19 or later, and RooCode and legacy Kilo sessions are excluded.
- Use `recall list --updated-since` or `--created-since`, or MCP `list_recall`, to list Recall entries by timestamp without a text query. Time-bounded lists include archived entries unless filtered by status. Without change tracking, narrow the bounds or filters if more than one page matches.
- Read term counts through MCP `get_term_trends` on daemon, PostgreSQL, and hosted backends. The Trends page was removed, and old Trends links open Sessions.
- Wait for startup ingestion or an archive rebuild with `agentsview session usage <id> --wait` through the daemon. If the wait expires after the session is found, the command shows saved totals and reports the incomplete wait. Archive-only waits work with API 15, while waits that refresh require API 17.
- Wait for project identification before exporting with `agentsview export sessions --wait`. The command starts the local daemon when needed and shows progress.
- Include per-session tool summaries in `agentsview export conversations changes --tool-summaries`. The export includes counts, errors, time by tool category, and invoked skills for sessions with stored tool calls. Archives last written by an older version need a writable open, such as a daemon restart, before listing summaries.
- Follow session and message changes over `GET /api/v1/changes/stream?after=<cursor>`. The stream can resume from a saved cursor and carries token and cost usage and origin machine IDs when available.
- Export Cursor account usage with `agentsview export hour --schema-version 6 --by-machine <hour>`. Only closed-hour events in the unfiltered poll that appear in exactly one numeric member query get account IDs. To count each account-hour once, use a reporting server that accepts schema 6 rows with `polled_at` and avoid mixing schemas 5 and 6.
- Search hosted raw-sync uploads by meaning with `agentsview session search --pg --semantic` after the server embeds them. Set `[vector]` and `[vector.embeddings]` on the server, run `agentsview replica pg hosted-provision provision`, and grant the runtime role access to the embedding tables. PostgreSQL semantic search requires pgvector 0.8 or later.
- Read connection secrets from private files with `[kata] token_file`, `api_key_file` for Docbank, insights, embeddings, or Recall extraction, and `cursor_admin_api_key_file` for Cursor. Configure one source per secret and restart the server after replacing a file.
- Map a gateway's model name to a catalog model with `price_as` under `[custom_model_pricing."<model>"]`. The mapped name follows the catalog model's rates and pricing tiers unless an exact custom rate applies to the reported name.
- Connect to Docbank over HTTP on a trusted private network with `allow_http = true`. HTTP sends the API key in plaintext.
- Record script and background job failures outside an agent session in the daily Friction Log with `agentsview diagnostics append` on SQLite or PostgreSQL. Repeated failures with the same source and message appear as one Diagnostics entry with a count for the day.
- With automatic Friction Log filing on, linked Kata issues closed as `done` reopen when a saved digest within `backfill_days` records a recurrence that happened after the close. The hourly job comments with the date it recurred.
- Add an `Agent-Session` trailer to commits made from a detected agent session with `agentsview git-hook install`. If a `commit-msg` hook already exists, the installer prints the line to add.
- Compare recorded request costs from supported agents with AgentsView's calculations in `agentsview session usage`. Positive recorded costs fill in when the catalog has no rate, and Claude Code's recorded session total appears separately as Agent total when available.
- Turn on search by meaning and build its index on a fresh install with `agentsview index embeddings build`. The command asks for approval before setup and requires a writable daemon.
- Capture a CPU profile with `--pprof` when serving the web UI from a PostgreSQL or ClickHouse replica.

## Improvements

- Transcripts show tighter tool-call rows and use a consistent reading column across layouts. Choose Default, Wider, or Full in the new Reading width setting under Appearance.
- Browser tab titles name the open screen, such as Activity or Usage. Open sessions get a short identifier in the title.
- After you pick a command palette result, the next Cmd+K restores the query and filters if you haven't reloaded the page. It highlights your pick if the results had finished loading, and the clear button starts a fresh search.
- HTML and Markdown session exports, published gists, and CLI exports with message text mask detected secrets by default. Use `--reveal` for CLI message exports or `reveal=true` for local, unproxied API requests.
- AgentsView sends usage events only after opt-in through Kenn or an explicit `TELEMETRY_ENABLED=1`. Changes to the shared choice take effect the next time AgentsView starts.
- The search index check at restart takes less time on large archives. On a 148 GB archive, the check took over 200 s before and now takes 0.07 s.
- The Dashboard and its agent filter finish sooner after the first load on long histories. On a synthetic archive of 91,711 sessions and 2,897,301 messages, the Dashboard finished in 7.5 s instead of 13 s after a message write, measured to the last panel as the median of five paired runs.
- Saved Tools, Velocity, and Signals panels appear sooner on repeat Dashboard visits on SQLite and PostgreSQL. SQLite and native PostgreSQL also reuse those panels after restart when the inputs match and the view has no active-since filter.
- On SQLite, Dashboard Tools refreshes changed sessions after a small sync. On PostgreSQL, the first Dashboard visit can reuse frustration counts once the startup fill finishes.
- On SQLite, unchanged Usage ranges reopen faster, and Usage and Activity load sooner when their cache starts empty. Upgrading from v0.47.0 or later to cache format 24 can reuse compatible facts from formats 21 to 23.
- All-time Usage loads faster on PostgreSQL after a restart or sync once the priced cache is ready, on journals newer than version 1. On ClickHouse, unchanged, fully prepared Usage selections within cache limits reopen faster after a same-day restart. After a next-day restart, only the all-history range gets this benefit.
- Activity queries run faster on SQLite and ClickHouse. PostgreSQL month and year views reopen sooner when saved report data is available after a graceful restart, including when sessions were pushed while the server was stopped.
- Repeat global search pages reopen sooner, even after a restart, on SQLite, native PostgreSQL, and ClickHouse when the query, filters, sort, and paging match and searchable data is unchanged. PostgreSQL also refreshes saved matches after a sync, including after a restart, when the saved checkpoint is still usable.
- On SQLite, `session search` stops scanning older sessions if recent exact matches fill the page. Filtered multi-word searches rank only matches in scope.
- When nobody is watching the archive, the daemon syncs changed session files at most once per `background_sync_interval`, which defaults to ten minutes. A CLI or MCP read through the daemon keeps the live sync pace for two minutes, so repeated reads during that time skip a new catch-up.
- `agentsview sync` is back in root help and runs without a deprecation warning. With a running daemon and up-to-date watcher coverage, manual sync applies the local changes the watchers collected. Use `--rescan` for a full pass.
- When native file watching fails, fallback polling can sync just the changed source files for Claude, Codex, and supported single-file JSONL providers.
- Remote sync can download just the appended bytes of a growing JSONL transcript if both ends support it and the saved copy's tail matches. Connecting to an offline HTTP remote now times out after 10 seconds instead of 30.
- ClickHouse pushes reuse stored messages and usage when a session only grows, and reuse unchanged session content after rebuilds and resyncs. Upgrade ClickHouse serving with the pushers.
- A file-triggered ClickHouse watch push skips writes when the archive has no changes for the replica. Daemon-backed PostgreSQL pushes can skip repeated schema checks in the same daemon run while the target schema still matches.
- The help for `agentsview serve stop` and `agentsview serve restart` now names read-only ClickHouse servers.

## Bug fixes

- AgentsView starts on x86-64-v2 CPUs. The DuckDB mirror and `agentsview replica duckdb` were removed. Use a PostgreSQL or ClickHouse replica for a read-only copy.
- Open session tabs can share live updates over HTTP/1.1 without blocking new pages. Selected-session live updates require API 28, and reloading shows new messages on API 27.
- Use an unambiguous plain UUID in MCP session tools, and keep it in the address bar when opening a session by that URL. Older remote servers before API 29 still require full stored IDs for required MCP lookups.
- MCP content search accepts `concepts` with `mode: "hybrid"` and lists a session's messages in order when given `session_id` without `pattern` or `concepts`.
- MCP errors for unknown arguments list the names the tool accepts. If a session search page is empty because matches were active in the last 10 minutes, it shows their count and suggests `include_active: true`.
- Failed page and transcript loads show an error and Retry. The command palette also retries a transient full-text search error once and offers Retry if it still fails.
- A live transcript refresh no longer jumps back to the current find match when new messages arrive.
- Pages served from PostgreSQL, including hosted PostgreSQL, wait for a connection when the server's pool is busy, and the pool stays within the login role's connection limit. Broad PostgreSQL session searches from MCP server mode and the command palette can complete past the server's write timeout.
- ClickHouse global search uses less query memory so large searches that hit the memory limit can return results.
- CockroachDB 25.4.6 can finish schema setup and accept session pushes.
- Hosted raw sync accepts uploads when the published container runs as a non-root UID with no passwd entry. A non-container install with such a UID still needs `DOCBANK_LOCK_DIR` set.
- Daemon-backed PostgreSQL and ClickHouse push watches follow committed archive changes on API 27 or later. Different daemon and client source roots no longer cause those change-triggered pushes to fail.
- Remote syncs requested through the daemon continue when the requesting client disconnects. On Windows, refused or unreachable remotes are skipped and reported as offline.
- On macOS, live sessions keep updating after a recursive folder watch drops events. Watches on folders one level deep also avoid a failure that could hang the daemon.
- Daemon restarts on Windows wait for the old process's archive write lock and can reopen the archive while an old shared-memory mapping lingers.
- AgentsView Desktop on Windows can unpack compressed in-app updates. If you're updating from an affected Windows release starting with 0.43.0, run the setup `.exe` once by hand.
- The desktop loading page shows database preparation and initial sync progress during background startup.
- `agentsview serve` holds its chosen port through startup when you use `--port 0` or when the default port is occupied.
- Claude.ai Chrome Sync skips chats whose list entry is missing the current leaf field instead of reporting an error for each one.
- `agentsview source cursor sync-usage` retries pages when Cursor rate-limits a request or returns a server error. It prints each wait so you can see why the sync paused.
- Cursor IDE chats in the `_v: 18` format import again. Mistral Vibe 3.1 sessions also sync from their unified stores.
- Compacted Grok Build sessions show earlier turns and a divider with each compaction summary when the source history is available. Tool calls also appear in the transcript.
- Codex transcripts show readable reasoning summaries and compaction dividers. Calls with identical token counts can still count as separate requests.
- Antigravity sessions use recorded workspace information for project and working directory, and nest subagents when a parent is recorded. Antigravity CLI summary imports keep the typed prompt when a skill expands in the same step.
- DeepSeek Harness messages keep their native IDs, so existing rows, pins, and exported message IDs survive live rescans as new frames arrive.
- Sessions from `<repo>.<branch>` sibling worktrees group under their repository when the checkout is missing from disk and the suffix matches the recorded non-default branch. Existing sessions pick up the change when they are reparsed.
- OpenCode-family usage counts reasoning tokens at the output rate when the usage record shows that output excludes them. Existing sources are reparsed in place.
- Usage totals include recorded tokens from replies with no visible text or tool call for affected agents, including Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI. Claude responses with a message ID are counted once when split by tool results, even if `requestId` is missing.
- Gemini 4 display names in Antigravity and bare `gemini-4-*` model IDs match Google's catalog rates. Older Antigravity display names such as `Gemini 3.5 Flash (High)` also match the pricing catalog. Exact custom rates still take precedence.
- Activity reports pick up changes when pricing is refreshed.
- Search index builds on the built-in local embedding server retry timed-out batches in smaller pieces. On SQLite, Message and Recall embedding builds can also publish when they overlap.
- PostgreSQL pushes stop if the local embedding index contains an all-zero vector. If a push reports one, run `agentsview index embeddings build --repair-invalid`.
- With `require_auth` and managed Caddy, failed stream requests no longer leave bearer tokens from request URLs in the daemon log.
- Growing Codex sessions no longer add deletion records for unchanged messages when sync can update the transcript in place. The daemon prunes expired records without native message IDs for reuse, and `db compact` can reclaim the space on disk.
- Commit links are recovered from older Codex shell calls that recorded Git commands as argument lists. In PostgreSQL and ClickHouse replicas, a retained link pushed by another archive no longer replaces a live session's prompts for the same commit.
- Prune removes matching parents and child sessions in one pass.
- Full transcript parses count dropped oversized JSONL records in the session's malformed-lines badge and sync summary. Undecodable data also counts for affected OpenCode, Shelley, and Forge records.
- `capture report` returns `finalization_timeout` when the wait expires before the first session lookup completes, so it can suggest retrying or allowing more time.

## Dependency updates

- Update Kit to v0.58.1 and `go.kenn.io/kata` to v0.23.0.
- Update Huma to v2.41.0 and `golang.org/x/crypto` to v0.59.0.
- Update the SQLite driver to v1.14.53, which bundles SQLite 3.54.1.

name: v0.11.0
body:
# GPUI Kit v0.11.0

GPUI Kit 0.11.0 is a minor release. It moves to gpui-pre 0.3.14 and GPUI Fast 0.1.19, makes the Linux X11 backend an optional default feature, replaces `chrono` with `jiff` in the date and time components, and brings a long run of editor, Markdown, diff and accessibility work. The X11 feature, the jiff types and the upstream GPUI API changes are breaking, so this is a minor release.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux X11 is a feature**: `gpui-kit/x11` is now a default feature. Apps that turn off the defaults and still run on X11 must ask for it; Wayland-only apps no longer link `libxkbcommon-x11`. ([#4060](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4060))
  ```diff
  - gpui-kit = { version = "0.10", default-features = false }
  + gpui-kit = { version = "0.11", default-features = false, features = ["x11"] }
  ```
- **Calendar, DatePicker, TimeField use jiff**: `Date`, `Matcher`, `CalendarState` and `TimeFieldState` take `jiff::civil::Date` / `Time` instead of chrono types, so `cargo deny` no longer flags the unmaintained `chrono` (RUSTSEC-2026-0543). Format strings are unchanged. ([#4015](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4015))
- **Upstream GPUI**: gpui-pre now also gives every `Element` a blanket `IntoElement`, so drop your own `impl IntoElement` on element types on both backends. `Path` is no longer generic, `WindowBounds::centered` takes `Option<DisplayId>`, and `FillOptions::tolerance` is gone. ([#4092](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4092))

## New APIs

- **Input**: a suggestion list under the field like `<input list>`; public `fold_all`, `unfold_all`, `fold_at_level` and `set_folded`. ([#3785](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3785), [#4028](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4028))
- **Editor**: `GutterStyle` for the line-number gap, color and font; show the active line only while focused. ([#3737](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3737), [#4067](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4067))
- **Diff**: `span_highlights` for character spans, the character under the pointer for hosting links, and partial files at their own line numbers. ([#4011](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4011), [#4042](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4042), [#4043](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4043))
- **Components**: resizable handle drag state, `SelectableText` range reveal, a left-side vertical scrollbar, and a `DockSkin` option to hide the resting split divider. ([#4039](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4039), [#4052](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4052), [#4078](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4078), [#4084](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4084))
- **Shell**: `PluginManager::with_host_module`. ([#3948](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3948))

## Editor and text input

- Faster soft wrap for large and non-ASCII documents; f64 vertical coordinates past 2^24 px and 9-digit line numbers; clip text to its side of the gutter. ([#3974](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3974), [#4022](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4022), [#4077](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4077))
- End IME composition on blur, redact IME surrounding text in masked inputs, report the document length so the iOS keyboard shows. ([#4032](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4032), [#4059](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4059), [#4082](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4082))
- Ctrl+Delete stops at white space and line breaks; a single-line input drops tabs like newlines; each paragraph of a text area starts at the edge it reads from; the input text takes the theme foreground. ([#4034](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4034), [#4071](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4071), [#4016](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4016), [#4051](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4051))
- Less accessibility text-run memory on large documents. ([#4090](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4090))

## Markdown and text rendering

- Inline flows lay out once in a shrinking bubble and wrap without rescanning the paragraph; inline-code paragraphs keep their text between frames; closing marks stay on the word's line. ([#4029](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4029), [#4058](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4058), [#4063](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4063), [#4087](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4087))
- Show Markdown as plain text if the parser panics; stop sweeping retained layouts that are all alive; select a wrapped row's first character; share linked-image clicks; expose the rendered body to the accessibility tree. ([#4013](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4013), [#4000](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4000), [#4012](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4012), [#4053](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4053), [#4056](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4056), [#4054](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4054))
- Highlighter injection layers follow the caller's parse timeout. ([#4074](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4074))

## Components

- **Diff**: file headers and annotation cards stay in the viewport while scrolling horizontally. ([#3996](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3996), [#4009](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4009))
- **Dialog, Notification, Popover, Root**: the backdrop stays inside the client frame; notifications sit above modal layers; a controlled popover moves focus after the frame; Tab works before anything is focused. ([#4049](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4049), [#3577](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3577), [#4023](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4023), [#4017](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4017))
- **Menu, Scrollbar, Table, Tabs, Resizable**: no scrollbar on a menu that fits; only the primary button drags the track; `set_selected_*` no longer scrolls; Tabs focus on pointer down; resizing skips hidden panels. ([#4014](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4014), [#4038](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4038), [#4046](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4046), [#4002](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4002), [#4064](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4064))
- **Title bar, Kbd, Motion, Icon, Button**: follow Linux window button layouts; shifted-symbol shortcuts on Windows; a closed `Presence` reports Absent; warn once for a missing icon path; expose the expanded state. ([#4018](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4018), [#3993](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3993), [#4062](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4062), [#4075](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4075), [#4035](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4035))
- **WebView**: no gaps at fractional sizes on macOS, clip partly visible WebViews on Windows. ([#4065](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4065), [#4066](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4066))

## Docs and tooling

- A Claude Code plugin for the GPUI Kit skills, fixed guide links in the standalone skills, a fuller zh-CN List guide, and the right canvas size for web examples in Firefox. ([#4089](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4089), [#4088](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4088), [#4030](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4030), [#4045](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4045), [#4048](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4048), [#4047](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4047))

## Dependencies

- gpui-pre 0.3.14 and GPUI Fast 0.1.19 (via 0.1.17); `chrono` replaced by `jiff` 1.0; Cargo.lock updated for 8 RustSec advisories; unused `anyhow` removed. ([#4027](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4027), [#4092](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4092), [#4015](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4015), [#4080](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4080), [#4081](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4081))

## Contributors

<details>
<summary>Thank you to everyone who contributed to this release</summary>

@huacnlee, @dux-web, @lurenjia534, @sassman, @bcl-dev, @hlcfan, @iam4x, @ylinwind, @ketansingrole, @ManasDasri, @Abdulrahman-AlGhamdi, @HappyFox001, @madcodelife, @jeeeeetshahhhhh, @byht1, @TheVSAKeeper, @yuluod, @costajohnt, @leonmarq, @sator-imaging, @bhavishyasharma, @iamichi, @subhdotsol, @wangdiandao, @superoskin, @peterdpong, @wyattjoh, @mwatts, @PeatBoy, @erenatas, @webmalex, @jowch, @glani, @HarpeLm.

</details>

<details>
<summary>What's Changed</summary>

* notification: Keep notifications above modal layers by @dux-web in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3577
* text: Stop sweeping retained layouts that are all alive by @lurenjia534 in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4000
* diff: Keep file headers inside the viewport under horizontal scrolling by @sassman in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3996
* kbd: Show a shifted-symbol shortcut as bound on Windows by @bcl-dev in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3993
* diff: Keep line annotation cards inside the viewport under horizontal scrolling by @sassman in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4009
* shell: Fix command_host second-draw test by @huacnlee in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4003
* diff: Add `span_highlights` to emphasize character spans such as search matches by @sassman in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4011
* editor: Speed up soft wrap for large and non-ASCII documents by @hlcfan in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3974
* tabs: Focus the roving handle on pointer down by @huacnlee in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4002
* text: Select a wrapped row's first character by @iam4x in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4012
* menu: Stop a scrollable menu that fits from showing a scrollbar by @ylinwind in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/4014
