body:
## 2026.11.7

### Highlights

- **Conversation recovery:** Recover interrupted replies and child results across Gateway restarts without losing pending work. (#198905, #201544, #200924, #200967) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @galiniliev, and @vincentkoc.
- **Reliable automations:** Let an automation’s owner conversation repair failures, and distinguish recovered or intentionally skipped runs from genuine failures. (#161007, #201638, #152165, #194276) Related #194261 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vyctorbrzezowski, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @pash-openai, @wr-web, and @slatem.
- **Smoother updates:** Finish Git and package updates through schema changes, busy databases, and retained recovery state instead of stopping before or after the new release starts. (#201600, #201463, #201545, #201330) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @fuller-stack-dev.
- **Responsive Gateway:** Keep chats, readiness checks, and unrelated sessions responsive during slow filesystem operations, large recovery packs, and page extraction. (#191236, #201248, #200623, #200925) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
- **Browser pairing:** Pair another browser with a short code approved on the Gateway host, with clearer instructions while approval is pending. (#191513, #200905) Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @daniel-lxs, @jalehman, and @etzelm.
- **Current ChatGPT catalogs:** Discover newly available subscription models without waiting for another OpenClaw release and keep sign-in discovery independent of npm. (#201130, #201493) Related #201480 Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @daniel-lxs.

### Changes

- **Knowledge search:** Find current records using superseded wording and match canonically equivalent Unicode keyword spellings. (#193742, #195092) Related #193054, #195031 Thanks @RomneyDa, @daniel-lxs, @Linux2010, @jalehman, and @saariuslystoned.
- **Talk transcription:** Use a saved Deepgram, ElevenLabs, or Mistral API key for live transcription. (#199858) Related #199684 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
- **Session control — breaking SDK change:** Move session-keyed setActiveEmbeddedRun(...) registrations into the host-provided runAttempt callback and retain their exact cleanup function; unadmitted registration now reports SESSION_CONTROLLER_ADMISSION_REQUIRED. (#175837) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @jalehman.
- **Gateway methods — breaking SDK change:** Replace mutable chatAbortControllers and chatQueuedTurns access with dispatchGatewayMethod from openclaw/plugin-sdk/gateway-method-runtime, declaring contracts.gatewayMethodDispatch: ["authenticated-request"] in the plugin manifest; existing caller permissions still apply. (#175837) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @johan-eilertsen, and @jalehman.
- **Start observation — breaking SDK change:** Update AgentTurnStartOwner.observe() consumers from expiresAtMs to startDeadlineAtMs; this is the execution-start deadline, not the execution timeout, and has no compatibility alias. See docs/plugins/sdk-migration.md for migration guidance. (#175837) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jalehman.

### Fixes

- **Reply and command boundaries:** Keep slash commands in ordinary prose from executing and warn before retrying a tool action whose reply was lost. (#200458, #201523) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen and @VACInc.
- **Stop and steering:** Answer messages sent after Stop, preserve steering through long-running tools, and let users steer while a Code Mode shell command runs. (#195612, #199878, #200998) Related #194303 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @amittell, @obviyus, and @VACInc.
- **Subagent results:** Keep results attached to their requesting turn and prevent one child’s delivery failure from dropping sibling results. (#200873, #201563, #195275) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @VACInc, and @jalehman.
- **Scheduled work:** Preserve automation ownership through account, sharing, and group changes, and keep scheduled global work in its existing conversation. (#201008, #201434, #188173) Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @jalehman, and @shakkernerd.
- **Claude CLI:** Retain final answers after progress messages, include long child results in completion turns, and show tool history with a custom Claude configuration directory. (#200470, #200226, #198337) Related #199633 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @gouyu-hou, @chaeyn, @obviyus, @etzelm, @VACInc, @mulderp82, @xiaoguomeiyitian, and @Szqub.
- **Codex:** Keep resumed conversations on the same native writer, distinguish API quota from subscription exhaustion, and preserve line breaks in streamed replies. (#201474, #192165, #201102) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jalehman, @vincentkoc, @TheRealUnknownSoldier, @VACInc, and @freeqaz.
- **Model and credential recovery:** Keep shared OAuth refresh with the running Gateway, use ambient AWS credentials for Bedrock Mantle, and report why a listed model rejects a request. (#198214, #190988, #200073) Related #163006 Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @netcrazed.
- **Compaction:** Use configured fallbacks after quota errors, avoid false post-compaction stall aborts, and preserve selected skills in sandboxed sessions. (#194813, #194722, #198029) Related #194803, #194715 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @VACInc, @saariuslystoned, @vyctorbrzezowski, @jason-allen-oneal, and @obviyus.
- **Telegram:** Finish large media uploads, retain callback controls when replacement delivery fails, and answer messages even when their attachment cannot download. (#151923, #193948, #200682) Related #193947 Thanks @RomneyDa, @amittell, @obviyus, and @AmelioMansour.
- **Discord and Slack:** Reconnect all Discord accounts after outages, keep independent requests from replacing active tasks, and keep top-level Slack completions top-level. (#201415, #201518, #187065) Related #162189 Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @mattreyes0824, @vincentkoc, and @wr-web.
- **Matrix and Feishu:** Preserve image captions and reply placement, show Matrix polls and votes in Element X, and finish long Feishu replies in the same streaming card. (#188018, #191700, #161777) Related #188038, #191678, #139443 Thanks @seriouslysean, @thatsrue, @obviyus, @chelsealong, @geekforlife, @ArthurNie, and @Simon2256928.
- **Voice calls:** Avoid raw JSON and truncated long answers, ignore echoed caller transcripts, and answer when background noise prevents endpointing. (#151367, #191537, #191498) Thanks @Weiming-Hu, @weiming, @obviyus, and @mnowrot.
- **Mobile and macOS:** Start a new Android chat while a response is running, accept native Talk setups, and let the macOS app answer its first chat without a false low-memory refusal. (#191372, #191194, #200373) Related #191339, #200340 Thanks @RomneyDa, @gouyu-hou, @saariuslystoned, @vyctorbrzezowski, @obviyus, and @jalehman.
- **Browser tools:** Keep the user’s Chrome tab focused, read text from the correct page after navigation, and capture background tabs in headless mode. (#134400, #196659, #201626) Related #196658 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @scotthuang, @martins-oss, and @obviyus.
- **Control UI:** Preserve dictation while microphone permission is pending, show transcription progress, and recover connections promptly after returning to the app. (#199069, #200235, #199887) Related #199065, #199875 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @daniel-lxs.
- **Fast navigation:** Open Channels and Devices without waiting for unrelated Chat or configuration work, and open Knowledge Browse without scanning unrelated stores. (#194393, #194795, #194792) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vyctorbrzezowski.
- **Configuration and Doctor:** Preserve guarded writes through symlinked state roots, restore reported truncated configuration, and avoid unrelated system Gateways blocking migrations. (#155538, #201501, #190194) Related #190177 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @mfurkanakinci, @vincentkoc, and @Satoshi-Kusumoto.
- **Backups and PostgreSQL:** Allow scheduled backups beyond ten minutes, protect verification from concurrent cleanup, restore through symlinked targets, and finish network database ports without hours of avoidable waiting. (#191346, #198659, #197795, #201374) Related #197779, #201249 Thanks @RomneyDa, @wangmiao0668000666, @vincentkoc, @chelsealong, @etzelm, @deepujain, and @evemorgen.
- **Update reporting and recovery:** Preserve warnings and accurate elapsed time, avoid asking owners to retry an update already running, and recover interrupted conversation state. (#194242, #194289, #188159) Related #188149 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @shakkernerd.
- **Installation and plugins:** Install local file URLs on Windows, stage native dependencies when execution is denied, and keep Git installs working while Node is being provisioned. (#190734, #193801, #195382) Related #195366 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @AmelioMansour, @wr-web, and @okbilinmeyen7komut-alt.
- **Memory and knowledge:** Recover indexing after embedding timeouts, support configured local Ollama hostnames, and recover interrupted Knowledge writes without duplicating repair work. (#191556, #191479, #193116, #198146) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @galiniliev, @Finn763, @triciah73, @jalehman, and @vincentkoc.
- **Sandbox and templates:** Keep turns working after the default sandbox image changes, avoid unrelated workspace contention, and allow retries after partially written template creation. (#193986, #197561, #199447) Related #193964 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @karam2022, @zhangguiping-xydt, and @obviyus.
- **Files and paths:** Handle Markdown carriage-return line endings, dotfiles and consecutive dots, and multiline frontmatter without losing text. (#200783, #197398, #199739, #198439) Related #200757 Thanks @RomneyDa, @LinzeShi, and @obviyus.
- **Retained work:** Restore retained downloads after worker reclaim, keep recently used worktrees out of idle cleanup, and preserve reconciled files during fast-forward. (#198102, #201333, #137942) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @jalehman, @joshavant, and @zhangguiping-xydt.
- **Long text pastes:** retain long pasted text in the composer as user text rather than automatically converting it into an attachment. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Usage reporting:** distinguish historical usage from live inference cost rather than presenting missing historical cost as a measured zero. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
- **Bundled Codex alignment:** align the ACP Codex override with the bundled 0.170.0 runtime while retaining ACP 2.2.2. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
- **Provider hooks:** preserve installed agent and plugin transport hooks when the SDK loads later, instead of replacing them with inactive defaults. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.11.6..3f05d1ac58c19a4bc5417e4685af2ffff56f7b22 history: 390 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 390 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

name: OpenWork v0.18.72
body:
## Bring your team's skills into OpenWork with their files

- **Bring skills over and use their supporting files.** Teams can import custom skills from Claude or GitHub and upload or download skills as ZIP files. Cloud skills can include scripts, templates, images, and other files; agents can read those files and run skill scripts, with the expected Python and Node libraries available on computers.
- **Chat actions and questions are easier to follow.** Run a suggested command directly from chat and the agent continues from its output. Questions appear beside the conversation, are less likely to ask about something you cannot see, and your answers and Automation review cards stay visible after the agent finishes. In Settings, Cmd+F (Ctrl+F on Windows and Linux) finds text on the page you have open.
- **AI Gateway setup and sign-in are clearer.** For admins: providers configured for members' own sign-in show as ready, provider edits save credentials and access correctly, and Vertex model choices save as expected. Desktop users can sign in again from models marked **Sign-in required**, and chat now identifies an AI Gateway usage limit instead of suggesting the provider is busy.
- **Workbot connects the tools your team actually uses.** It now offers every app your admin set up, and new workspace owners signing in from Workbot can add team tools before chatting. If you connect an app during a conversation, Workbot can use it in the same reply.
- **The built-in browser and everyday chat feel more dependable.** Browser pages open at a normal, readable size, links widen a narrow panel, and split-chat app previews open in the panel you can see. Chat no longer flickers when you send a message, and you can start a side chat from text across multiple agent replies.
- **Organization access and connected work behave more predictably.** GitHub sources need workspace approval before connecting or syncing; GitHub imports stay private until you share them. Requiring SSO no longer blocks agents, Workbot, and Automations, while invitations use the regular email-verification flow.

Full changelog: https://openworklabs.com/docs/changelog · [Compare](https://github.com/different-ai/openwork/compare/v0.18.71...v0.18.72)

name: CC Switch v4.0.40
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.40

本版本让 **Grok Build 的官方卡可以绑定授权中心里的 xAI 账号**，像 Claude、Codex 官方卡一样在多个 Grok 账号之间切换。**插件页**支持 Antigravity CLI；**用量统计**的供应商和模型列表加了缓存命中率；**小米 MiMo** 内置余额和 Token Plan 额度查询；授权中心的账号卡片跟随侧栏应用的顺序和隐藏设置。

本版本还加固了深链接导入 MCP、用量脚本、SQL 导入和非本机监听地址的安全检查，并提升了数据库、本地路由、用量同步、会话搜索和「应用」页的速度。另外修复了 Kimi Code Desktop 主 agent 的用量没统计；Antigravity 输出速度从 4.0.38 起虚高；T3 Code 和单独运行的 ACP 里的 Antigravity 会话看不到；Mistral 官方 API 开思考后回复为空；Kimi 原生 Responses 在并行看图工具调用后一直报 400；WorkBuddy 企业账号积分显示为已用完；托盘里看不到 xAI 额度、官方账号显示成网站域名；Skills 页的「发现」里出现重复的技能；「应用」页要等版本检查完才显示安装状态等问题。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.40-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.40-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### Grok 官方卡绑定 xAI 账号

Grok Build 的 Grok Official 表单加了「登录方式」（[#9321](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9321)，关闭 [#8599](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8599)），可以选授权中心里的 xAI 账号、添加或管理 xAI 账号，或者「跟随 Grok CLI 登录」，用法和 Claude、Codex 官方卡一样。

- 每个绑定的账号是一张单独的卡，名字带上账号，可以加任意多张；不绑账号的仍是原来那张固定的卡。
- 切到绑了账号的卡时，CC Switch 会先刷新这个号的登录，再把它写进 Grok CLI 的 `~/.grok/auth.json`，文件里的其他内容不动。Grok CLI 已经登录着这个号时不写；网络暂时失败时提示稍后重试，账号确实失效才提示去授权中心重新登录。
- 换号前，Grok CLI 当前登录的号会先收进授权中心；切回「跟随 Grok CLI 登录」的卡时，还原成第一次换号前的号。
- 在授权中心删掉账号时，如果 Grok CLI 正在用的是 CC Switch 替这个号写的登录，会还原原来的登录，原来的号也没了就退出登录。
- 绑了账号的卡，卡片、用量和托盘的额度都按这个号查。没绑账号的卡在 Grok CLI 的登录过期时，改用授权中心里同一个用户的账号查额度。

### Antigravity CLI 插件

「插件」页支持 Antigravity CLI（[#9882](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9882)、[#9885](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9885)），和其他应用一样调用 `agy` 自己的命令行，可以在「发现」里浏览官方和合作伙伴市场的插件，安装、启用、停用、卸载和更新。

- 更新前先比对市场上的版本号，已是最新就不重装。
- 插件被正在运行的 Antigravity 会话或后台服务占用时，提示先关掉再重试。
- 旧版 Antigravity 应用装的插件放在数字命名的目录里，CC Switch 无法替它更新，会提示卸载后在「发现」里重新安装。

### 用量统计：按供应商和模型看缓存命中率

用量统计的「供应商」和「模型」列表在 Tokens 后面加了「命中率」一列，能看出是哪家供应商、哪个模型没吃到缓存。算法和请求日志里的命中率一样（缓存命中 ÷ 可缓存输入），各行的缓存命中和可缓存输入加起来与顶部的总数一致；没有可缓存输入的行显示「—」。

### 小米 MiMo 余额和 Token Plan 额度

小米 MiMo 的供应商内置了两种官方查询（关闭 [#9404](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9404)），不用再靠抓控制台 Cookie 的用量脚本：

- Token Plan（`tp-` 开头的 Key）：显示已用和总额度，以及本期结束时间。
- 余额（`sk-` 开头的 Key）：显示可用余额（扣除冻结部分），余额为 0 不会被当成 Key 无效。

### 授权中心卡片跟随侧栏应用

授权中心的账号卡片按「应用」页里拖动的应用顺序排列。只有用到这个账号的应用全都隐藏了，卡片才隐藏（Copilot、ChatGPT、xAI 账号还会被 Claude Code 等应用的供应商用到）；从供应商表单跳过来的那张卡总是显示。

### 新增预设

新增 StringAI。

---

## 变更

- **数据库与本地路由更快**（[#9820](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9820)、[#9821](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9821)）：主数据库改用 WAL 模式，路由每次请求要读的配置、路由、定价和故障转移队列改从缓存读，路由的数据库操作移到单独的线程，不再占住处理请求的线程；转发请求时少复制一次对话内容，没有改写过的请求不再重复跑隐私过滤。
- **用量同步更快**（[#9817](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9817)、[#9818](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9818)）：各应用的会话日志并行扫描；用量脚本在单独的线程里运行，不再拖慢其他请求。
- **会话内容搜索更快**（[#9827](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9827)、[#9896](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9896)）：一两个字的搜索不再扫描全部正文；继续输入时，上一次还没完成的搜索会被取消。搜索索引格式有变，升级后第一次搜索会重建索引。
- **「应用」页打开更快**（[#9418](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9418)、[#9886](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9886)，关闭 [#9884](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9884)）：先按本机的安装路径显示「已安装 / 未安装」分组，不用等每个工具的版本检查；各工具的版本同时检查，查完一个显示一个。

---

## 安全

- **深链接导入 MCP**（[#9831](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9831)）：确认框显示 MCP 服务器的全部字段（包括工作目录、请求头等），高危字段标红提示。会读取本机环境变量、执行辅助命令、把工作目录指向网络共享路径，或地址不是 http / https 的配置，直接拒绝导入。
- **用量脚本**（[#9829](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9829)）：脚本发出的请求不再跟随重定向，不能发给 CC Switch 自己的路由端口，响应最多读 2 MiB；填进脚本的 Key、地址等变量会正确转义。深链接里的用量查询地址也会检查，是内网或本机地址时确认框会提示。
- **SQL 导入**（[#9832](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9832)）：导入 SQL 备份或 WebDAV / S3 同步快照时，不允许创建触发器和视图，文件最大 512 MiB，执行超过 30 秒即中止。
- **非本机监听地址的 Host 检查**（[#9833](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9833)）：路由服务监听 `0.0.0.0` / `::` 时，来自本机的请求也要通过防 DNS 重绑定的 Host 检查。

---

## 修复

- **Kimi Code Desktop 主 agent 的用量没统计**（[#9505](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9505)，见 [#9498](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9498)）：Kimi Code Desktop 1.3.5 换了会话日志格式，主 agent 的用量被跳过，子 agent 的模型显示为 `unknown`。现在两种格式都能读，不会重复计算；升级后会重新扫描一次旧日志，补上以前漏掉的用量和模型。
- **Antigravity 输出速度虚高**（[#9858](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9858)）：4.0.38 起，思考较久的请求能显示几万 tok/s。Antigravity 的输出 token 含隐藏的思考，首字时间也包含思考时长，现在改回按完整耗时计算。
- **T3 Code 和单独运行的 ACP 里的 Antigravity 会话看不到**（[#9857](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9857)，见 [#9838](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9838)）：这些会话现在会出现在会话列表和用量统计里。它们没有可用的恢复命令，也不能在 CC Switch 里删除；T3 Code 加在提问外面的说明会去掉，标题显示原本的提问。
- **Mistral 官方 API 开思考后回复为空**（见 [#9902](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9902)）：开了思考的 Mistral 官方 API（包括它提供的第三方模型）把回复拆成思考和正文两种片段返回，本地路由读不出来，回复为空或没有思考过程。现在两种片段都能按顺序读出；发给上游的请求不变。
- **Kimi 原生 Responses 在并行看图后一直报 400**（[#8825](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8825)，见 [#7504](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7504)）：Codex Desktop 会在并行工具调用的结果之间插入提示，Kimi 这类严格的原生 Responses 上游会丢掉不紧跟调用的结果，这个会话之后每轮都报 400。现在先把这批结果收齐放在一起，再放插入的提示。
- **WorkBuddy 企业账号积分显示为已用完**（见 [#9694](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9694)）：企业账号改查企业用量，显示总额度、已用和到期时间；不限量的显示「不限量，已用 N」，查不到额度时报查询失败，不再显示「已用完（共 0）」。
- **托盘里看不到 xAI 额度**（见 [#9899](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9899)）：Codex、Claude Code 里的 xAI OAuth 供应商（包括 Codex 聚合的成员）在托盘里也按绑定的 xAI 账号显示额度，没绑定时用授权中心的默认账号，和主界面卡片一致。
- **托盘里官方账号显示成网站域名**（[#9863](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9863)）：绑了托管账号的 Codex 官方卡，以及 Codex OAuth、GitHub Copilot、xAI OAuth 卡，托盘副标题显示登录的账号（手动备注优先）。主界面的 xAI OAuth 卡片也显示账号；在授权中心登录、切换默认账号、删除或退出登录后托盘会跟着更新。
- **Skills 页的「发现」里出现重复的技能**：同一个仓库里末级目录同名的两个技能会装进同一个目录，「发现」里原来显示成两行，现在只显示离仓库根目录最近的那个。
- **OpenCode Desktop 自带的 CLI 被提示用 npm 升级**（[#9099](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9099)）：这份 CLI 的安装来源显示为 OpenCode Desktop，并说明它随 Desktop 应用更新，不再计入「全部升级」；单独安装的 OpenCode 照常升级。
- **快到 64 MiB 上限的流式事件被误跳过**（[#9867](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9867)）：4.0.39 加的缓冲上限改成按单条事件判断，接近上限的正常事件不会再和同一块里的下一条一起被丢掉。

---

## 升级说明

- 路由服务监听 `0.0.0.0` / `::`、又在本机用自定义主机名（不以 `.local`、`.internal`、`.localhost` 结尾）访问路由的，升级后会收到 403，需要在设置「本地路由」的「连接地址」里填上这个主机名（这个地址也会写进各客户端的配置）。局域网、WSL、Docker 里的其他设备不受影响。
- 会话内容搜索的索引会在升级后第一次搜索时重建，会话多的话第一次会慢一些。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @Owlbay（Grok 官方卡绑定 xAI 账号）、@funkpopo（Antigravity 插件、「应用」页版本检查提速、CI 提速、路由 Host 检查）、@YUZHEthefool（安全加固、数据库与路由提速、用量同步提速、会话搜索提速、托盘账号副标题）、@Chenning-Tao（Kimi Code Desktop 用量）、@ZhenWang-BIT（Antigravity 输出速度、T3 Code 会话）、@Fansway（Kimi 并行工具调用）、@teddyli18000（OpenCode Desktop CLI 升级）、@wlndysky（「应用」页冷启动）、@allenxu09（托盘账号副标题、评审修改）、@HaiYangBG1（流式缓冲上限、代码整理）、@SaladDay（测试与代码整理）的贡献。

感谢 @yzw7489757、@Fonsi479、@spy123-1、@Xavier9896、@PorkneckRon、@wintervault、@cxhzzb 报告问题和提供复现信息。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

name: v2.4.0
body:
### Highlights

- **Built-In Desktop Browser**: Import your sign-ins and browsing history from Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, and add extensions from Chromium browsers or the Chrome and Edge stores. Everything stays in one persistent desktop profile: chat links open signed in, your tabs survive restarts and the agent can read and drive the same pages without you switching apps. ([#63002](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63002), [#65073](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65073))
- **Automations**: Ask the agent to run a prompt, a script or a shell command on a timer, on a cron schedule or when an MCP server sends an event, and manage them with `/automation`. Set `"automations": false` in your config if you don't want them. ([#65296](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65296), [#65186](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65186))
- **Generate Videos**: When a connected provider has a video model, the agent can make videos with `generate_video`. It keeps working while the video renders and saves the files into your workspace when they're ready. ([#63666](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63666), [#65664](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65664))
- **New TUI Look**: The TUI's new designs are on by default, and the `opencode` theme is the new one. Pick `opencode-classic` in **Theme** to keep the previous colors. ([#64988](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64988))
- **Windows Taskbar Status**: On Windows, the taskbar button shows session progress, counts sessions that need you and flashes when a permission or question is waiting. ([#65317](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65317), [#65318](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65318), [#65319](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65319))

### Upgrade notes

- **Image tool renamed.** `experimental_image_generate` is now `generate_image`. Permission rules with the old name are mapped automatically, but saved "always allow" approvals are not, so it asks again once. ([#65682](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65682))
- **Plugins that follow a version now update on their own.** A plugin written as `name@latest`, a version range (such as `name@^1.2.0`), a Git branch or a Git `semver:` range is checked on startup and every 24 hours, and a newer match is installed and reloaded. Ranges never leave their range, and if a new version fails to load the previous one keeps running. A bare `name`, an exact version, another tag such as `@next`, a Git tag or a commit hash doesn't update itself; `opencode plugin update` still updates those by hand. ([#64764](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64764), [#65052](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65052), [#65056](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65056))
- **GitHub Copilot no longer reads `GITHUB_TOKEN`.** Set `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` or sign in with OAuth. ([#64697](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64697))
- **MCP servers are tried on the newest protocol first.** A server without a `protocol` setting is probed before falling back to the legacy handshake. Set `protocol: "legacy"` on a server that misbehaves. ([#65282](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65282))
- **The TUI `opencode` theme changed.** It now means the new theme; set `opencode-classic` for the previous look, and `experimental["new-designs"]: false` in your TUI config for the previous designs. ([#64988](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64988))
- **Chat links open in the browser pane.** In the desktop app, web links from the chat open beside the conversation. Modifier-click a link to open it in your system browser. A `browser` deny in your permission rules refuses every agent browser call. ([#63002](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63002))
- **OpenCode Go connects through OpenCode.** The connect dialogs and `opencode auth login` list one **OpenCode** option that includes Go models. **OpenCode Go** is only listed when a Go key is already saved, and saved keys keep working. ([#65466](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65466))
- **New desktop shortcut.** `Cmd+Shift+S` (`Ctrl+Shift+S` on Windows and Linux) now archives the open session. The composer's `Cmd+U` and `Escape`/`Ctrl+G` now follow the **Attach file** and **Stop session** shortcuts. ([#65428](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65428), [#64394](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64394))
- **Code Mode session tool paths moved.** `tools.opencode.session_rename` and `session_move` are now `tools.opencode.session.rename` and `.move`. Direct tool names and permission actions are unchanged. ([#65080](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65080))
- **TUI plugins need OpenTUI 0.9.4.** `@opencode/plugin` requires `@opentui/core` and `@opentui/solid` 0.9.4 or later. Renderers passed to `registerCodeBlockRenderer` now receive an OpenTUI block (`block.text`) instead of a Markdown token; `codeBlockStyle` and `escaped` are gone. ([#63989](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63989))
- **SDK: plugins load in the background again.** Plugins are meant to load asynchronously, and the server never waits for them. In v2.2.7 the model, provider, `generate.*`, `voice.*` and `websearch.query` endpoints started waiting up to 5 seconds for plugins and returning 503 after that ([#63040](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63040)); this release removes that wait. Right after startup these endpoints answer with whatever has loaded, so a list can be empty or partial. Long-lived clients should refresh on the matching `*.updated` event, such as `model.updated`. One-shot scripts should wait on their side, for example by polling `plugin.list` until it returns plugins, or the endpoint until the entry they need appears. ([#63814](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63814))
- **Desktop voice needs a matching server.** The app reads each voice model's engine, which older servers don't report, so voice shows as unavailable against a server from before this release. ([#65506](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65506))
- **Storage write path.** Assistant parts are now saved as their own rows. `experimental.part_rows: false` restores the old path for this release. ([#65039](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65039))

### Core

#### Improvements

- Added automations. Agents can schedule prompts, Code Mode scripts or fixed shell commands to run once, on an interval, on a cron schedule or when a connected MCP server pushes an event. Use the `/automation` command or the `automation` tools. A shell action asks for approval once, when it's created, and records each run's exit code and output. Set `"automations": false` to turn them off. ([#65296](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65296), [#65186](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65186), [#65217](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65217), [#65236](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65236), [#65001](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65001), [#65699](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65699))
- MCP Events shipped: OpenCode follows the MCP Events beta for push delivery, with argument checks, heartbeats and automatic reconnects. An event too large for its prompt is skipped and its automation keeps running. ([#65271](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65271), [#65673](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65673))
- MCP servers without a `protocol` setting now negotiate the newest MCP protocol and fall back to the legacy handshake. ([#65282](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65282))
- Agents can generate videos with `generate_video` whenever a connected provider has a video model. The job runs in the background, survives a server restart, saves the finished videos into the workspace and wakes the agent with their paths. Set a default model with `experimental.video_generate.model`. The image tool is now called `generate_image`. ([#63666](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63666), [#64546](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64546), [#65664](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65664), [#65682](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65682))
- Plugins that follow a version (`name@latest`, a version range, a Git branch or a Git `semver:` range) are checked on startup and every 24 hours, and a newer match is installed and reloaded without a restart. A range stays within its range, and if a new version fails to load, the previous one keeps running. Other plugins still only report updates. ([#64764](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64764), [#65052](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65052), [#65056](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65056))
- The Claude Agent provider has a `configDir` setting for a Claude config folder other than the default. Given a list of folders, a chat moves to the next account when one hits its usage limit. Claude Agent sessions also show up in Claude Code as coming from `opencode`. ([#62514](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62514), [#65035](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65035), [#65016](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65016))
- Removing a Sign in with ChatGPT account, with `opencode auth logout` or the remove button in the app, now also revokes it with OpenAI. ([#64947](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64947))
- The ChatGPT plan model lists now come from models.dev, so new models show up without an OpenCode update. ([#65579](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65579))
- Voice models are now listed from models.dev, adding newer OpenAI models such as `gpt-live-1.1`. ([#65491](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65491))
- Reading far into a large file with `read`, or reading its tail, takes far fewer reads, which is much faster on remote workspaces. ([#65611](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65611))
- The shell tool's result says why a command ended without an exit code, and lists its output after the smaller fields so they survive truncation. ([#65365](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65365), [#65513](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65513))
- Code Mode scripts can define getters and setters, errors have a `stack` showing where they were thrown, and a failed import says why. ([#64908](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64908), [#64939](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64939), [#64587](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64587))
- A `timeout` set on a provider now applies to every request, including image, video, speech, transcription, embedding and compaction requests, which previously could hang forever on a stalled provider. ([#64692](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64692))
- Gemma 4 models on Google's Interactions API offer the `none` and `thinking` variants, and the provider's `safetySettings` are sent to Interactions. ([#65038](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65038), [#65036](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65036))
- Added `claude-agent` as a web search provider. With Claude Agent connected, set `"websearch": { "provider": "claude-agent" }` to run `websearch` through Claude Code's WebSearch, which Claude plans include, so any model can search without a search API key. ([#65704](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65704))
- With `full_codemode` on, agents can call `tools.opencode.session.interrupt` to stop another session, its background jobs and its subagents. ([#65718](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65718))
- Stored blobs, such as generated videos, are deleted a week after they were written, so the data folder no longer grows without limit. Copies saved into your project are untouched; `GET /api/experimental/blob/:id` returns 404 for a deleted blob. ([#65671](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65671))
- Config now reloads only when a file that feeds it changes, not on every write under `.opencode` such as editing a skill. ([#62158](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62158))
- Each streamed assistant part is saved as its own row instead of rewriting the whole message on every update, so long steps with many tool calls save reliably. ([#65039](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65039))

#### Bug fixes

- Fixed GitHub Copilot picking up `GITHUB_TOKEN`, which git tooling and GitHub Actions often set without Copilot access. It now reads `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN`. ([#64697](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64697))
- Fixed shell commands the scanner can't analyze, such as dynamic execution, failing outright. They now ask for permission, and a matching `shell` deny rule still blocks them. ([#65269](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65269))
- Fixed sessions getting stuck on provider 400 errors after a model called a tool by a dotted name such as a Code Mode path. A Code Mode tool called at the top level now runs as that tool, with a note telling the model to use `execute`. ([#65292](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65292), [#65193](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65193), [#65494](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65494))
- Fixed a forced tool choice for a namespaced tool naming a tool the request never declared on every provider except native OpenAI Responses. ([#65621](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65621), [#65726](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65726))
- Fixed the shell tool's description not saying which OS and shell commands run in when `full_codemode` is on. ([#65712](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65712))
- Fixed a revoked or expired ChatGPT sign-in failing every prompt with "Request failed: 400". It now asks you to connect again. ([#65289](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65289))
- Fixed `edit` and `patch` replacing every non-UTF-8 character (Latin-1, cp1252, GBK…) with `�` across the whole file. They now refuse to rewrite such files. ([#64868](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64868))
- Fixed the review pane showing every line as changed in repositories with `core.autocrlf=true`, and symlinks as modified with `core.symlinks=false`. ([#64884](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64884))
- Fixed file permission rules not matching other capitalizations of the same path on macOS. Thanks @knp-sap. ([#64626](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64626))
- Fixed the model picker staying empty while a slow project was still loading. ([#63814](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63814))
- Fixed Claude Agent processes staying alive after their session was deleted. Thanks @WTLAIB. ([#62649](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62649))
- Fixed Claude Agent models becoming unavailable after Claude Code renamed them, and Claude Agent now waits up to 60 seconds for its process to start. ([#65032](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65032), [#65064](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65064))
- Fixed shell commands failing with "failed to open output file" after OpenCode's shell output directory was removed. ([#64889](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64889))
- Fixed concurrent shell commands failing on Windows with PowerShell 7 from the Microsoft Store, and stopping one such command killing the others. ([#64901](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64901))
- Fixed `opencode service set password` writing the password to the CLI log. ([#64911](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64911))
- Fixed `opencode run` hanging when a FIFO is passed as an attachment; it's now rejected right away. Thanks @yang0228. ([#64696](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64696))
- Fixed `opencode <name>` crashing with a stack trace when `<name>` is neither a command nor a directory. It now prints help and the error. ([#65262](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65262))
- Fixed the background service becoming unresponsive at startup with a large database write-ahead log on a slow disk. ([#64532](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64532))
- Fixed a client that opens a session during a running tool call not seeing that tool's progress, such as a running subagent's session. ([#64929](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64929))
- Fixed Markdown commands dropping a separate `variant` next to `model`, and agents being skipped when frontmatter repair turned inline lists or objects into strings. ([#65118](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65118), [#65119](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65119))
- Fixed Google Interactions responses stopping early when Google splits a response across requests. ([#65006](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65006))
- Fixed GPT models over OpenAI's WebSocket transport resending the whole conversation after a freeform tool call such as `execute` or `patch`. ([#64706](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64706))
- Fixed `gpt-6.2-astra` and later Astra models getting a 500k context window with ChatGPT sign-in; they stay at 272k. ([#64725](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64725))
- OpenAI `cyber_policy` and Gemini "terms of use" refusals are now reported as content policy errors. Thanks @lu-zero. ([#64844](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64844), [#64910](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64910))
- Fixed MiniMax text-to-video requests without an aspect ratio being rejected; they now default to `16:9`. ([#64822](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64822))
- Fixed several Code Mode built-ins to match Bun: `localeCompare` and `Date` `toLocale*` honor their locale and options, `toBase64`/`fromBase64` honor their options, `Buffer` `map`, `filter`, `slice` and `subarray` return a Buffer, and `Uint8Array.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT` is defined. ([#64935](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64935), [#64938](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64938), [#64931](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64931), [#64933](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64933), [#64930](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64930), [#64965](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64965))
- Fixed large file views not refreshing when only the end of the file changed. ([#65114](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65114))
- Fixed the install script failing with a disk-space error when `curl` is installed through Snap. ([#65132](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65132))

### TUI

#### Improvements

- The new TUI designs are on by default, and the theme named `opencode` is the new theme. The previous default is available as `opencode-classic`, and `opencode2` keeps working as an alias of `opencode`. To go back to the previous designs, turn off **New designs** in the Experiments dialog. ([#64988](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64988))
- `/login` and `/auth` open the same dialog as `/connect`, which now lists a single **OpenCode** entry that includes OpenCode Go models. ([#65265](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65265), [#65466](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65466))
- Pressing `↓` opens the picker on the first tab with something running, the same tab that clicking the footer opens. ([#64972](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64972))
- Text prompt dialogs such as rename session, `/btw`, worktree names and connect forms end with a **Submit** button, and prompt and export dialogs have tighter spacing. ([#64944](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64944))
- The `opencode` theme's light mode uses lighter grays for the prompt box, selected tabs and hovered rows. ([#64962](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64962))

#### Bug fixes

- Fixed connect forms built from integration fields, such as the Azure resource name, showing an empty row between the title and the input. ([#64944](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64944))
- Fixed list dialogs ending with two blank rows, and the **Manage workspaces** footer not staying at the bottom. ([#64983](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64983))
- Fixed long dialog lists replacing their last visible row with a stray `…`. ([#64934](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64934))
- Fixed the selection bar of a delete-confirmation row staying blue instead of red. ([#64936](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64936))
- Fixed file, agent and skill mentions landing on the wrong text when you restore a prompt sent from the desktop or web app that contains tabs or wide characters. ([#63989](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63989))

### Desktop

#### Improvements

- The browser pane keeps you signed in. Links from the chat open beside the conversation in one saved profile, you can import sign-ins and browsing history from Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari and other browsers, and you can install store extensions after reviewing what they can access. The pane gains a right-click menu, find in page, page dialogs, permission prompts, pop-up blocking and readable error pages, and the address bar completes from your history. The agent can read and drive the same signed-in tabs. ([#63002](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63002), [#65073](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65073))
- New tabs that a page opens in the browser pane appear beside the tab they came from, and middle-clicking a link opens it in a new tab. ([#65126](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65126), [#65091](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65091))
- Comments in the browser pane, file viewer and review diff can be sent to the session right away with `Mod+Enter`. Depending on your follow-up setting, they send, steer or queue. ([#65264](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65264))
- Added **Wrap code blocks** under Settings › General › Timeline, plus a **Wrap lines** button on timeline code blocks with lines too long to fit. ([#64545](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64545), [#64576](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64576))
- Added **Keep side panel open across sessions** in Settings › General. ([#64950](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64950))
- Added an **Archive session** command, bound to `Cmd+Shift+S` (`Ctrl+Shift+S` on Windows and Linux). ([#65428](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65428))
- The Home session menu has **Open** and **Open in background**, and Home shows the provider connect hint when nothing is connected. ([#65209](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65209), [#65212](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65212), [#64885](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64885))
- The Inbox layout's sidebar has a **Drafts** group for unsent new-session drafts. ([#65525](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65525))
- Conversation search (`Cmd+F` / `Ctrl+F`) has previous and next match buttons. ([#64865](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64865))
- The connect dialog lists one **OpenCode** option that includes OpenCode Go models, Settings › Providers follows the same rule, and the free model picker has a tighter layout. ([#65466](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65466), [#65740](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65740), [#64927](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64927))
- When you reach your ChatGPT Business workspace's usage limit, a dialog explains it and offers **Copy request for admin**. ([#64926](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64926))
- Voice uses the newest GPT-Live model the server lists. ([#65506](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65506))
- Shortcuts go through the same keymap engine as the TUI, and the new **Stop session** command can be changed in Settings › Shortcuts. ([#64394](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64394))
- Shortcuts can be key chords, such as `Mod+K Mod+C` or `G I`. In Settings › Shortcuts, click **+** on a shortcut you just recorded to add another key, up to 4. While a chord is pending, a panel lists the keys that continue it. ([#64395](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64395))
- The activity pill keeps a subagent listed while work it started is still running. ([#64790](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64790))
- The goal pill has a new design with the labels Following goal, Goal paused and Goal reached. ([#60001](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60001))
- Keyboard focus shows as one consistent ring across the app, no longer appears after a mouse click, and moves to the next item when the focused one is removed. The timeline and the composer no longer draw a ring around their whole frame. ([#64909](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64909), [#64976](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64976), [#65082](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65082), [#65084](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65084), [#65100](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65100), [#65690](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65690))
- Only the latest response shows its Copy button all the time; older ones show it on hover or focus. ([#64640](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64640))
- Added experimental tab groups for side tabs under Settings › Experimental. ([#64407](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64407))
- On Windows, the taskbar button shows session status as a progress bar, a count badge for sessions that need you, and flashes when a permission or question is waiting. Notifications say what is being asked and disappear once you answer. ([#65317](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65317), [#65318](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65318), [#65319](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65319), [#65325](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65325), [#65421](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65421))
- On Windows, the jump list has **New Session** and **New Window**, you can drag files from the file tree into other apps, and **Open in** includes Windows Terminal and lists only installed apps. ([#65327](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65327), [#65330](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65330), [#65320](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65320))
- The web app can be built to run under a path prefix, for example behind a reverse proxy, with `bun --cwd packages/app build --base=/opencode/`. ([#64597](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64597))
- The background activity menu stays smooth with many subagents, and the model picker stays responsive with catalogs of thousands of models. ([#65634](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65634), [#65189](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65189), [#65635](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65635))

#### Bug fixes

- Fixed `opencode://open-project` and `opencode://new-session` links doing nothing. ([#65332](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65332))
- Fixed file links like `~/Downloads/clip.mp4` showing "File not found". `~` now opens in the server's home folder. ([#65689](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65689))
- Fixed an open session's side panel tabs disappearing after you had used many other sessions. ([#65328](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65328), [#65322](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65322))
- Fixed the app freezing when opening a session on a remote server with **Share sign-ins with remote servers** on. ([#65339](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65339))
- Fixed the app freezing for several seconds when you open a group of long Code Mode scripts. An Execute row now lists its latest 10 calls, with **+N more** for the earlier ones. ([#65696](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65696))
- Fixed the browser pane showing "The browser couldn't open" in a project whose server had only just started. ([#65720](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65720))
- Fixed **Clear browsing data** clearing everything on the first click; it now asks first. ([#65124](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65124))
- Fixed browser tabs showing a generic globe instead of the site's icon, saved tabs appearing late after the app reopens, and the page going blank while a panel is resized on Windows. ([#65094](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65094), [#65067](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65067), [#65083](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65083))
- Fixed sites in the browser pane replacing the app's badge on the taskbar or Dock. ([#65646](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65646))
- Fixed the mouse Back and Forward buttons doing nothing. ([#65129](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65129))
- Fixed a subagent's pending permission request not reappearing after a reload or reconnect. ([#65120](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65120))
- Fixed background jobs that changed while the job list was loading showing the wrong state, and rows in the activity menu jumping around. ([#64966](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64966), [#65312](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65312))
- Fixed the session view crashing when a timeline row disappeared mid-update. ([#64565](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64565))
- Fixed earlier replies being folded into the "Used N tools" group when a session was woken without a new message. ([#64917](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64917))
- Fixed the Context tab showing the latest instruction update as the "System Prompt". ([#64991](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64991))
- Fixed the session header briefly showing the wrong worktree while a new session starts. ([#65190](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65190))
- Fixed Grep, Glob and List rows showing the parent of the folder they searched, and Windows paths not showing relative to the project. ([#65460](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65460), [#65639](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65639))
- Fixed server event streams going stale after Windows wakes from sleep, and windows reopening in the wrong place after being snapped or minimized. ([#65321](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65321), [#65323](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65323))
- Fixed the Windows caption buttons being hard to see with a contrast theme. ([#65324](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65324))
- Fixed **Open in PowerShell** on Windows opening Windows PowerShell instead of PowerShell 7 when it's installed. ([#64873](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64873))
- Fixed builds packaged without `app-update.yml`, such as AUR packages, showing update-check errors. Settings now shows **Updates unavailable**. ([#64681](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64681))
- Fixed the message menu's "Today" and "Yesterday" labels, and Home's date headers staying invisible while scrolling. ([#65081](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65081), [#64665](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64665))
- Fixed clipped or misleading focus rings, the side panel's add button being skipped by `Tab`, and the **Compacted** label only partly highlighting on hover. ([#65215](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65215), [#65192](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65192), [#65176](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65176), [#65177](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65177), [#65211](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65211), [#65213](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65213), [#65644](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65644))
- Fixed the Hex voice tip showing on phones and tablets, and a fringe on project icon corners. ([#64583](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64583), [#64582](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64582))

### SDK

#### Improvements

- Added `experimental.job.cancel` to cancel a running background job, and an `experimental.job.updated` event when a job starts, moves to the background or ends. `@opencode/client/solid`'s `createData` has a `job` slice. ([#64790](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64790), [#65266](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65266), [#64956](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64956))
- The video endpoints (`experimental.generate.video.create` and `.get`) no longer need a flag. Video jobs survive a server restart, can return more than one video, and stay readable for 24 hours after they finish. ([#65664](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65664), [#64546](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64546))
- The automation endpoints work without a flag, and an automation can run a shell command as its action. ([#65296](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65296), [#65186](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65186))

### Extensions

#### Improvements

- A plugin tool can set `options.codemode` to an object (`{ pinned?, description?, input?, output? }`) to give its Code Mode form its own description and schemas. Top-level `options.pinned` still works but is deprecated. ([#64515](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64515))
- The `execute.before` and `execute.after` tool hooks receive `info`, the tool's definition, and `codemode`, which is true when a Code Mode script made the call. ([#64515](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64515))
- An integration's OAuth method can define `revoke` to sign a credential out remotely before it's removed. ([#64947](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64947))
- TUI plugins can read a session's running background jobs with `api.data.job.list(sessionID)` (experimental). ([#64956](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64956))
- `experimental.idle` background entries can have the kind `video`. ([#63666](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63666))
- GUI plugins can declare their own SVG icons with `Plugin.define({ icons })` and use them through `ctx.icons`. The built-in `outline-pair` and `outline-steer` icons were removed. ([#64577](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64577))
- The GUI composer API adds `composer.send(commentID)` and `composer.delivery()`, and the `Browser` contract adds `experimental.open` and `experimental.close`. ([#65264](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65264), [#63002](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63002))
- GUI `System.open` only launches HTTP, HTTPS and mail URLs, and `Browser.open` refuses `file://` URLs outside the built-in preview. ([#63002](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63002))

> In case you haven't heard of it before, ripgrep is a line-oriented search
> tool that recursively searches the current directory for a regex pattern.
> By default, ripgrep will respect gitignore rules and automatically skip
> hidden files/directories and binary files.

ripgrep 16 is a new major version release of ripgrep that mostly has bug fixes,
some minor performance improvements and a small number of new features. Here
are some highlights:

* There is now an `--in` flag for telling which files ripgrep should search
by pointing to another containing line delimited file paths. (There is also a
corresponding `--in0` flag for NUL delimited file paths.)
* ripgrep now has a `-G/--glob-not` flag, which is recommended in lieu of using
`!` to negate a glob. That is, `-g '!*.toml'` can now be spelled as
`-G '*.toml'`.
* ripgrep now respects a new `RIPGREP_THREADS` environment variable for setting
the default number of threads to use for parallel searches. Whenever
`-j/--threads` is specified on the command line (or in a configuration file),
it takes precedence over the environment variable.
* `riscv64` has been re-added to ripgrep's release pipeline. Binaries can now
be downloaded for that target.

Enhancements:

* [#3522](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3522):
Add new `-G/--glob-not` flag for negating `-g/--glob`.
* [#3425](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3425), [#3622](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3622), [#3511](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3511):
Add nushell completions via `--generate complete-nushell` (#3425).
* [#3255](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3255):
Add Zed hyperlink alias.
* [#2962](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/2962):
Add POSIX character class support in bracket expressions.
* [#3035](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3035):
Add `--max-bytes` flag to limit bytes per file.
* [#273](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/273), [#3459](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3459):
Add --in/--in0 flags for reading file paths.
* [#3317](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3317), [#3415](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3415):
Support RIPGREP_THREADS environment variable.
* [#3620](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3620), [#3617](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3617):
Delay-load userenv.dll on Windows MSVC.

Bug fixes:

* [#3609](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3609), [#3603](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3603):
Reject partial path components when stripping Unix prefixes.
* [#3605](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3605), [#3604](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3604):
Continue reading ignore files after invalid UTF-8 lines.
* [#3607](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3607), [#3614](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3614):
Statically link binary on Windows ARM64/MSVC (#3607).
* [#3593](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3593):
`-v -m N -A k` printing the rest of the input as matches.
* [#3581](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3581), [#1764](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/1764):
`-g !DIRNAME/` couldn't match when the CWD is `DIRNAME`.
* [#2552](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/2552):
Don't report ignored broken symlinks when following links.
* [#3577](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3577):
Hostname buffer size at HOST_NAME_MAX.
* [#3382](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3382):
Preserve buffered matches after parallel search errors.
* [#3526](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3526):
Hyperlink paths that are not valid UTF-8.
* [#2745](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/2745):
Exclude path separator from character classes.
* [#3534](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3534):
Detect symlink loops above the search root.
* [#3617](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3617):
Don't compare against stdout when it's a pipe on Windows.
* [#2958](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/2958):
Sanitize paths by removing control codes in output.
* [#3527](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3527):
Treat lone `!` gitignore line as a no-op.
* [#3484](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3484):
Separate Scheme from Lisp file types.
* [#3342](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3342):
Detect compressed files by magic number, not just extension.
* [#3477](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3477):
Parse trailing spaces correctly in gitignore patterns.
* [#1983](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/1983), [#3364](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3364):
`--json` should emit multiple matches in multiline mode.
* [#3222](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3222):
Separate flags from paths in decompression commands.
* [#3503](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3503):
Fall back past MAX_LOOK_AHEAD in multi-line match discovery.

Documentation:

* [#3598](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3598):
Clarify PATH environment variable in flag documentation.
* [#3551](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3551):
Note that nesting `{...}` alternates is allowed.
* [#3538](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3538):
Document git divergence in matched_path_or_any_parents.
* [#3243](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3243):
Emit .TP for each flag entry to generate linkable anchors.
* [#3500](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3500):
Clarify that the `-r/--replace` flag is not recursive search.
* [#3323](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3323):
Remove `$` prompt symbols from README code blocks.
* [#3448](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3448):
Update guide examples for a more recent release.

Performance:

* [#3597](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3597), [#3594](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3594):
Skip path resolution when hyperlinks are disabled.
* [#2832](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/2832):
Honor custom line terminators in the regex engine.

name: v1.3.11
body:
[English](#en-v1.3.11) | [中文](#cn-v1.3.11)

Highlights

- Added **[Aigei](https://www.aigei.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=sponsorship&utm_campaign=moneyprinterturbo)** as a stock video source. - Added **useapi.net** as a source for AI video and images. - Added **APINEBULA, APIXO Responses, AtmoRouter, and MartLLM** (formerly UberLLM) as LLM providers. - Improved **local rendering performance** by reducing per-frame compositing work for subtitles, letterboxing, and slide transitions. - Local video projects now return **individual rendered scene clips** in timeline order. This release also fixes cropping for footage with non-square pixels and reduces redundant cache verification during repeat renders. - Updated **Gemini speech synthesis** to Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS and improved **Edge TTS** timeout handling so long narration can finish while data is still arriving. ## Fixes and Improvements - Fixed FFmpeg audio validation that could accept a damaged MP3 or reject a valid short clip. Long files are checked without buffering the entire validation output. - Improved stock footage selection and playback. Sequential mode uses the rest of a clip before repeating it, faster playback gets enough footage to cover narration, and Pixabay can use a suitable 1080p file instead of downloading 4K. - Kept polling Seedance jobs when an Ark-compatible gateway reports `pending`. - Improved subtitle alignment with script lines and kept titles such as “Mr.” and “Dr.” with the names that follow. Accepted full-width brackets in narration pause tags. - Fixed voice previews that used the interface language instead of the selected voice’s language. Refined Spanish WebUI translations and file-size formatting. - Removed Markdown code fences from generated narration and preserved the first sentence when falling back to a social title. - Omitted or null API voice names use the default voice. CLI batch entries with a null voice inherit the batch voice. The API rejects blank scripts on `/audio` and `/subtitle`, and a null aspect ratio on `/videos`, before queuing a task. - Preserved Unicode separators inside JSONL strings. Cleared stale failure information after a successful local-project retry and made the agent helper honor `MPT_HOME`. ## What's Changed - Aigei, APINEBULA, and APIXO Responses integrations · [Aigei](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/d4877bc) · [APINEBULA](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/075f7ac) · [APIXO](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/110b14d) - useapi.net material sources by @useapi. 重点更新

- 新增 **[爱给网](https://www.aigei.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=sponsorship&utm_campaign=moneyprinterturbo)** 视频素材来源。 - 新增 **useapi.net** AI 视频和图片素材来源。 - 新增 **APINEBULA、APIXO Responses、AtmoRouter 和 MartLLM**（原 UberLLM）大模型服务。 - 优化**本地视频渲染性能**，减少字幕、留黑边和滑动转场的逐帧合成开销。 - **本地视频项目**现在可按时间线顺序取得各场景的成片。修复非方形像素素材裁剪后变形的问题，并减少重复渲染时的缓存校验。 - 将 **Gemini 配音**迁移到 Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS，改善 **Edge TTS** 超时处理，让持续接收数据的长文案配音能在总时限内完成。 ## 修复与改进 - 修复 FFmpeg 误接受损坏 MP3、误拒有效短音频的问题。校验长音频时按流读取，减少内存占用。 - 改善库存素材的下载与播放。顺序模式先播完当前片段再重复，高倍速下会下载足够覆盖旁白的素材，分辨率足够时优先使用 Pixabay 的 1080p 文件，减少不必要的 4K 下载。 - 兼容 Ark 网关返回的 Seedance `pending` 状态，任务排队期间继续轮询。 - 改善字幕按原稿行对齐的效果，避免把 `Mr.`、`Dr.` 等称谓与后续姓名拆到不同字幕行。配音停顿标签支持全角方括号。 - 试听示例按所选音色的语言播放，修复界面语言不同时的试听问题。完善西班牙语 WebUI 文案和文件大小显示。 - 清理 AI 生成文案中的 Markdown 代码块标记，生成备用社交标题时保留首句。 - API 省略音色或显式传入 `null` 时使用默认音色，CLI 批任务传入 `null` 时继承批次音色。`/audio`、`/subtitle` 的空白脚本以及 `/videos` 的空画幅会在入队前报错。 - 保留 JSONL 字符串里的 Unicode 分隔符。修复本地项目成功重试后仍显示旧失败阶段的问题，并让 Agent 辅助工具正确使用 `MPT_HOME`。 ## 主要变更 - 爱给网、APINEBULA 和 APIXO Responses 接入。 [爱给网](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/d4877bc) · [APINEBULA](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/075f7ac) · [APIXO](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/110b14d) - name: v16.1.0
body:
### Standalone Cloud Sync in the installer

- Run `npx claude-mem install` and choose Cloud Sync to connect your devices while keeping your current memory provider. The monthly plan requires a card and includes a full 30-day trial, followed by $12 per month. The annual plan costs $99 upfront.
- The installer carries your chosen plan into checkout and verifies that cmem.ai confirms the same offer. Hosted tokens are a separate, optional purchase. Existing bundled Pro setups keep their saved settings.
- You can skip Cloud Sync during setup and keep memory local. Once the installer applies a choice, returning to the plan screen or reloading it preserves that choice.

name: v16.0.4
body:
## Fixes

- **Chroma search works again while the embedding model downloads** (#6399, closes the "Invalid port" part of #6365 reported by @FengJie2004, root cause found by @kevincommits). httpx 0.28 misread a bracketed IPv6 entry such as `[::1]` in `NO_PROXY` and failed with `Invalid port: ':1]'`, so chroma-mcp could not add documents and search fell back to FTS5. The chroma-mcp child now gets the same host without brackets (`::1`). Entries with a port, and every other entry, are unchanged.
- **Context injection keeps observations whose concepts are an old plain string** (#6393, thanks @jiangjiang248, closes #6389 reported by @soarkit). Keyword search matched a legacy concept such as `缓存`, but context injection dropped the same observation. Both now read concepts through one shared SQL expression, so they cannot drift apart again.
- **OpenCode Go answers My Work refresh and corpus steps** (#6395, thanks @HemanRamlal). The API agent now sends the `x-opencode-session` header OpenCode Go requires (one id per run), and turns reasoning off with `reasoning_effort: none`, which Go honors. Before, every step failed with `400 MissingSessionID`, or ran out of its answer budget while thinking.
- **Expired live observer inputs are counted and reported** (#6394, thanks @Zhong-fan, closes #6391 reported by @abhiroopb). The live buffer still drops an input nobody claims within five minutes, and still never replays it. The WARN line now carries a running total, and `/api/processing-status` returns it as `expiredObserverInputs`, so the loss is visible without reading logs.
- **`/api/tool-uses` refuses a bad date instead of ignoring it** (#6387, thanks @kevincommits). A `dateStart` or `dateEnd` that was not a number (an ISO date, a typo, or the parameter given twice) was dropped, and the listing returned rows from every date. It now answers 400 `INVALID_DATE`. Epoch-millisecond values work as before.
- **`/api/dedup/candidates` refuses a fractional limit instead of answering 500** (#6388, thanks @REI-330). `limit=2.5` failed with `datatype mismatch`. A limit that is not a whole number now answers 400 `limit must be a whole number`, and the store clamps what it binds so a negative limit cannot read every row.
- **`/api/advisor-calls` caps its offset like every other listing** (#6396, thanks @DeryFerd). A huge `offset` made SQLite scan and discard rows on the worker's shared connection. It now uses the shared listing cap, and a viewer that keeps paging stops with `offsetCapReached`.

## Hosted sync service

- **The sync API checks the projector URL before sending its secret** (#6397, thanks @DeryFerd). `INTERNAL_PROJECTOR_URL` now follows the same rules as `FORWARD_ORIGIN` (absolute https, plain http only for loopback, no credentials, query or fragment) and fails at startup. Before, a typo or an `http://` address sent the internal bearer secret in cleartext. This changes `services/sync-api`, which is not part of the npm package: it reaches users only once that service is deployed.

## Internal

- One helper now decides whether a listing offset is past the cap (#6398, thanks @DeryFerd). Behavior is unchanged.
- The 16.0.3 changelog now tells OMP users to run `npx claude-mem install --ide omp` once to get the server-runtime fix.

name: Skill Recorder v0.9.4
body:
# Skill Recorder v0.9.4

This is a **source-only release**. No application installers or portable binaries are attached. GitHub's source archives contain the tagged repository source; the commands below build the application locally.

**Release commit:** `f4f9e2b6ac58f71da8e2bbd9fde34e65390a7ae8`

## Security and compatibility

- Mask detected secrets even when terminal chunks, pagination, time windows, or excerpt boundaries split their values.
- Detect printed multiline private keys using bounded, overlapping scan windows.
- Preserve ANSI control-sequence state across terminal chunks so split color sequences do not hide tokens from detection.
- Mask raw text before JSON escaping and truncation in analysis tools.
- Preserve existing UI/UX flows, tool result formats, saved recordings, pagination, and protection-off behavior. No dependencies or recording formats changed.

These fixes address four independently reproduced redaction gaps in v0.9.3. Protection remains a best-effort safety net: avoid recording real credentials. Upgrading does not remove data previously sent to an AI provider or alter existing local recordings. If real credentials were captured and analyzed, consider them potentially exposed and rotate them according to your organization's security procedures.

## Commit-pinned installation

To upgrade, use the appropriate command below. Finish any active recording and quit running copies before launching the new version. Windows installation does not launch the app automatically; use the Skill Recorder (Source) shortcut after installation completes.

### Windows 11 x64 or ARM64

```powershell
$commit="f4f9e2b6ac58f71da8e2bbd9fde34e65390a7ae8"; $env:SKILL_RECORDER_COMMIT=$commit; irm "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/skill-recorder/$commit/install.ps1" | iex
```

### macOS or Ubuntu

```sh
commit="f4f9e2b6ac58f71da8e2bbd9fde34e65390a7ae8"; curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/skill-recorder/$commit/install.sh" | SKILL_RECORDER_COMMIT="$commit" bash
```

For inspect-first installation and advanced options, see [INSTALL.md at the release commit](https://github.com/microsoft/skill-recorder/blob/f4f9e2b6ac58f71da8e2bbd9fde34e65390a7ae8/INSTALL.md).

## Installer-script SHA-256

Calculated from the exact release commit's Git blobs:

```text
766a2797cff1223266fb56b8c82bb77653dd42dcf3bcc7ffeefa6328bcd8c22d  install.ps1
bd8b5200a2c140c5a5ed9299d565ac72cee5420181774008977eaf75f210db1d  install.sh
```

name: v0.9.118
body:
A batch of extractor, resolution, serve, export, clustering and reporting fixes across fourteen community pull requests. The Objective-C, C and C# changes alter node/edge output, so the AST cache schema bumps (51 to 53) and the first build after upgrading re-extracts the affected languages; the other fixes need no rebuild.

- Fix: **csharp** a local, parameter or field named `partial`, `required`, `async`, `nint`, `nuint` or `with` (contextual keywords) that tree-sitter-c-sharp mis-parses where a statement starts with it no longer derails the file; it is rewritten to its verbatim `@name` form before parsing (byte-length preserving), so the enclosing type and the members after it are kept instead of being silently dropped (#5043, thanks @ThatAblaze).
- Fix: **c** a call through a struct function-pointer field (`ops->run()`, `ops.run()`) no longer fabricates a `calls` edge to a same-named free function; the field name is no evidence of the pointer's runtime target, so the guess is dropped. A plain direct call still resolves (#5410, thanks @sdivyanshu90).
- Fix: **objc** an Objective-C method whose name folds onto a sibling's id within one `@interface`/`@implementation`/`@protocol` (a leading/trailing `_` as in `-setup`/`-_setup`, or a case-only difference) gets its own salted node id instead of overwriting it; the declaration and definition of one method still share a single node (#5390, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **go** a struct field's owner type is scoped to its own package, so a field of a type whose name is declared in two packages binds to the right one and its member calls resolve instead of being dropped as ambiguous (#5408, thanks @azizur100389).
- Fix: **extract** a Svelte import that comes through an `export *` barrel now resolves to the real defining module, matching plain `.ts`. The cross-file resolver was masking `.vue` but not `.svelte`, so the Svelte `<script>` imports were lost to a template parse error; chained barrels resolve and ambiguous re-exports fail closed. Run `graphify extract . --force` once to repair an already-cached graph (#5403, thanks @Max17190).
- Fix: **extract** audio and video files that are detected but not extracted (headless extract has no transcription step) are now reported in the summary instead of silently vanishing, matching the other skip notices; no nodes are fabricated for them (#5076, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **sections** `get_section`'s retry no longer reuses the full graph's trigram search index. The retry ran against a networkx subgraph view whose `.graph` dict is the same object serve caches the index on, so the retry searched stale, out-of-section ids and raised `KeyError`; the retry view now gets its own graph metadata, which also removes a shared-graph index-corruption hazard for concurrent serve callers (#5385, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
- Fix: **serve** the MCP server loads `graph.json` off the event loop, so a large graph reload no longer blocks concurrent requests; a request during a reload is served the current graph and a corrupt reload leaves the old graph intact (#5371, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
- Fix: **update** a clustered `GRAPH_REPORT.md` that is deleted while the graph is otherwise unchanged is regenerated instead of being skipped by the no-change gate; the graph itself is left byte-identical (restored from the partition cache) so there is no needless rebuild (#5402, thanks @Max17190).
- Fix: **query** image nodes are demoted in seed scoring alongside documents and papers, so a caption-rich image no longer out-seeds real code for a query whose terms it happens to repeat (#445, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **export** export filenames honor the target filesystem's `NAME_MAX` (probed via `pathconf`, not assumed to be 255), so `graphify export obsidian/wiki/canvas` no longer aborts with `ENAMETOOLONG` on filesystems that report a lower limit such as eCryptfs (143); long names are truncated with a hash suffix and internal links use the shortened names (#2109, thanks @Synvoya).
- Fix: **wiki** directed-graph exports now include incoming edges, so a community audit no longer under-reports confidence (an incoming AMBIGUOUS edge could be invisible while the page read "EXTRACTED 100%"). On god-node pages incoming edges are marked `(incoming)` so a relation like `calls` is not read backwards (#5369, thanks @sdivyanshu90).
- Fix: **config** `.graphifyrc` now parses `demote_docs` / `query_demote_docs`, so a project can set doc demotion in the rcfile instead of only via the CLI flag; an explicit flag still overrides it (#5290, thanks @debojyoti10CC).
- Perf: **cluster** community-overlap counting during a rebuild is computed from shared nodes in one pass instead of intersecting every pair of communities, turning an O(communities squared) step into a linear one with byte-identical results (#5382, thanks @Max17190).

body: Agents' faces show what they're doing, even at small sizes. Settings has more face sets to choose from, and each changes expression with the agent's mood. Settings shows each agent's state once, and Loop folds to its small form when it goes offline.

name: Impeccable Loop 0.2.2
body: With nothing waiting, Loop's first card copies a short prompt so your agent can say hi, and its hello arrives as its first card. Loop no longer wakes a Codex session that ran with full access; its card waits for you.

name: v2.2.2
body:
### Fixes
- fix: a Fake-IP DNS name in 198.18.0.0/15 passes the SSRF guard after a once-per-process .invalid probe; literals and all other ranges stay blocked (#1403)
- fix: only an absolute missing cwd walks up to its nearest existing parent; GP3 and Windows cases follow (#1409)
- fix: Claude Code PostToolUseFailure takes the narrow matcher, a foreign MCP failure spawns no hook (#1408)
- fix: Claude Code registers PostToolUseFailure, so a failed host tool gets its toolerr row (#1408)
- fix: ctx_doctor answers when the project does not resolve (#1410)
- fix: zcode MCP session id from _meta.session_id, the id its hooks journal under (#1411)
- fix: a cwd that does not exist yet resolves to its nearest existing parent, hook no longer denies (#1409)
- fix: hook writes under a held write lock wait 250 ms, then spool and drain on the next hook (#1401)
- fix: Claude Code persisted Bash output: the replace pointer names the file the host saved, so the agent can Read it with offset and limit (#1406)
- fix: a plugin mod's MCP call (toolu_plugin_) gets its output whole; the text is still indexed and model calls stay replaced (#1402)
- fix: a proxy from env is not an SSRF target; the target is checked on every hop (#1403)
- fix: ctx_search names an unknown source past offset and picks a source inside the asked scope first (#1390)
- fix: OpenCode skill tool result reaches the model whole (#1404)
- fix: compaction now:/asked/decided lines use the first line with text when the body starts with blank lines (#1400)

### Who gets this

One version on both channels: the release commit on main (GitHub) and npm.

| Agent | Channel | Update with |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | GitHub | `claude plugin update context-mode@context-mode` |
| Codex | GitHub, npm for the one-time hook trust step | `codex plugin marketplace upgrade context-mode` |
| Gemini CLI | GitHub | `gemini extensions update context-mode` |
| Qwen Code | GitHub | `qwen extensions update context-mode` |
| Copilot CLI | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| VS Code (Copilot) | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| Kiro | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| ZCode | GitHub | `zcode plugins update context-mode@context-mode` |
| Pi | npm | `pi update --extensions` |
| OpenCode | npm | `opencode plugin update` |
| OMP | npm | `omp plugin upgrade context-mode` |

# Cua Driver 0.59.2

## Summary

This release includes 2 fixes.

## Fixes

- wait for a woken Chromium AT-SPI tree before the first Linux walk. ([#7886](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/7886)) reported by @BlankParticle.
- refuse macOS clicks on controls behind an attached sheet. ([#7798](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/7798)) Thanks @muness.

## Contributors

Thanks to @BlankParticle, @muness for contributing to this release.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on
their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned
`cua-driver-rs-v*` releases directly.

body:
# Cua Driver 0.59.0

## Summary

This release adds 1 feature.

## Features

- add metadata-only RuntimeWitnessV0 contract. ([#7952](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/7952)) Thanks @hippoley.

## Contributors

Thanks to @hippoley for contributing to this release.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on
their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned
`cua-driver-rs-v*` releases directly.
